Step 3: US gasoline inventory drawdowns of 30.8 million barrels over recent months are unprecedented, indicating genuine physical tightness.
Step 4: Exports to Asia to fill shortfalls there have reduced domestic US supply, adding to the physical tightness not visible in headline futures.
Step 5: The gap between manipulated futures and physical reality means both policymakers and investors are underpricing the severity and duration of the energy shock.
